Laplace transforms

Source: R/integrals-laplace.R
laplace_transform.Rd

Ports of SymPy's laplace_transform and inverse_laplace_transform (sympy/integrals/laplace.py). laplace_transform(f, t, s) returns list(F, a, cond): the transform, its half plane of convergence re(s) > a and an auxiliary condition; with noconds = TRUE only F. inverse_laplace_transform(F, s, t) returns the inverse (by default without conditions). expand_dirac_delta() splits an expression linear in DiracDelta terms into the remainder and the coefficients.

Usage

expand_dirac_delta(expr)

laplace_transform(f, t, s, noconds = FALSE, simplify = FALSE)

inverse_laplace_transform(
  F,
  s,
  t,
  plane = NULL,
  noconds = TRUE,
  simplify = FALSE
)

Arguments

f, F, expr

Expressions.

t, s

Variables.

noconds

Return only the transform.

simplify

Simplify the result.

plane

The half plane of convergence, or NULL.

Value

The transform, or a list with the conditions.

Examples

t <- Symbol("t", positive = TRUE); s <- Symbol("s")
laplace_transform(exp(-2*t), t, s)
#> [[1]]
#> 1/(s + 2)
#> 
#> [[2]]
#> -2
#> 
#> [[3]]
#> True
#> 
inverse_laplace_transform(1/(s + 2), s, t)
#> exp(-2*t)
